name: Bond market volatility
summary: Treasury volatility index MOVE at 106 on 20 Nov, above the 100 Watch line; US 10-year yield 4.91%
state: The MOVE index of Treasury volatility closed near 106 on 20 Nov, back above the 100 Watch line (Yahoo Finance). The US 10-year yield ended near 4.91%, about 8bp lower over the month and well inside the 40bp line (Yahoo Finance). No disorderly auction or emergency Fed action was found.
for_you: Borrowing costs tied to US Treasury yields, including some mortgages and corporate loans, are moving more than usual from day to day.
why: US Treasuries price almost every asset on earth; when the 'risk-free' market becomes volatile, funding and collateral chains strain.
drivers: Inflation data, Fed path, deficits and auction demand, foreign holder flows, liquidity.

rubric.alert: MOVE > 140, or disorderly Treasury trading (failed/tailed auctions with Fed action, emergency buybacks).
rubric.watch: MOVE 100–140, or US 10y moved ≥ 40bp in a month, or weak auctions flagged.
rubric.normal: MOVE index < 100 and US 10y moved < 40bp over the past month.
